solution.Text: Is there no solution to the conflict?

which_gate.Text: What exit gate do you think I should choose to go through?

politics.Text: Hi there! What do you think about the political situation on Rubi-Ka?  I just don't get it.  Honest, I don't.  Clans or Omni-Tek, it doesn't matter.  All they do is bicker and fight.  Never, ever have they looked for a rational solution.  Instead they just go back and forth, back and forth, accomplishing nothing.  It's getting old real fast, if you ask me, and it's about time somebody did.

solution.Text: Sure there is.  Get the ICC to intervene, cancel Omni-Tek's lease, arrest clan terrorists, and get some proper law-enforcement.  Heck, give the lease to the Sol Banking Corporation!  I'm sure they'll make a better job of it than Omni-Tek has.  Or put Jobe in control.  They seem to know what they're doing.

Text: {delay 2} When I came here I chose to be neutral, and I do not regret that.  But back then I did not have the option to go to and work with the scientists in Jobe and get an apartment in the sky-city.

recommend.Text: Yes!  It will ensure you more knowledge and power, plus it is very exciting.  And it keeps you away from the aliens.

Text: Yes!  Haven't you heard?  As if the ongoing conflict between Omni-Tek and The Clans isn't enough, some strange creatures have found their way to Rubi-Ka, and their ships are attacking homes of innocent people!
{delay 1} No, you better go to the Shadowlands if you want to live life the easy way.
